response.original_title: 【FAQs™ Official】 How do I add a Passenger on a MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise booking, ☎ +1-877-619-8065 (US) or +1-877-619-8065(UK) you must call MSC Customer Service directly or contact your travel advisor, ☎ +1-877-619-8065 (US) or +1-877-619-8065(UK) as this cannot be completed online or through the mobile app.
